title: Definite objects
summary: Mark definite objects with the accusative `-(y)I`, soften p, ç, t and k before a vowel, and use pronouns as objects, at the market and at the breakfast table.
canDo: Say whether you mean a thing or the thing
Buy fruit and vegetables and ask how much they are
Say who you know, miss, remember or are waiting for
Spell nouns that change their last letter before a vowel
